stage0016_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$レディ$$
「...That covers the survey results for each colony,
　conducted jointly with Londo Bell.」

stage0016_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$大統領$$
「Riots everywhere... pacifists turning violent...
　Still no idea what's causing it...?」

stage0016_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$大統領$$
「I'm not asking to hear an apology.
　What I want is results.」

stage0016_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$大統領$$
「We plan to hold talks with Rep. $$ハマーン$$,
　but at this rate, there's no hope of improvement.」

stage0016_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$大統領$$
「Hurry.
　In the assembly too, holding back the military's
　hard-line push is nearly at its limit.」

stage0016_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カティ$$
「The $$大統領$$ seems on edge too.」

stage0016_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$レディ$$
「Hawkish lawmakers backed by the military
　keep loudly demanding a hard-line stance.」

stage0016_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カティ$$
「So even public opinion is slowly shifting
　to accept forced colony inspections...」

stage0016_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$レディ$$
「All the more reason to find a lead at L3,
　and ready bargaining material before the $$大統領$$
　meets with $$ハマーン・カーン$$.」

stage0016_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カティ$$
「So you think something will happen
　during the joint exercise held there...」

stage0016_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$レディ$$
「Of course, if nothing happens,
　that would be for the best.」

stage0016_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$レディ$$
「But the location itself is the issue.
　Even our surveys so far show Colony X-18999
　has plenty of suspicious points.」

stage0016_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$レディ$$
「Its roots trace back to before the Destruction
　Incident... before the colony's Gundam
　ever descended to Earth.」

stage0016_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$レディ$$
「The chance something happens at the exercise,
　and the shadow lurking in X-18999...
　Both carry serious danger.」

stage0016_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カティ$$
「For the exercise, I sent in someone I trust
　in case something happens.
　They're reporting the full situation to me.」

stage0016_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$レディ$$
「Londo Bell's Commander $$ブライト$$ is heading
　there as well, but even so,
　we're still short-handed...」

stage0016_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
???
「I'd like a $$プリベンター$$ codename as well.
　Let's say... I'll go by Wind, the breeze
　that puts out fires.」

stage0016_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
???
「Then if you're taking the name Wind,
　I'll take the code Lightning.」

stage0016_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
???
「Heh... the $$プリベンター$$s' Wind God and Thunder God.」

stage0016_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0016_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0016_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0016_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0016_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Let me ask you straight, $$カミーユ$$.」

stage0016_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you think the pilot of that red mobile suit
　was $$シャア$$?」

stage0016_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What do you think, Captain $$アムロ$$?」

stage0016_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The one piloting it was
　$$シャア$$, and yet not $$シャア$$...
　That's the plainest way I can put it.」

stage0016_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I don't think it was Captain $$クワトロ$$.」

stage0016_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That might just be wishful thinking
　on my part.」

stage0016_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I can't believe Captain $$クワトロ$$, who fought
　alongside us, would try to change the world
　by waging war.」

stage0016_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I feel the same way.
　Keep 'fixing' the world by such means,
　and denying $$トレーズ$$ and $$ゼロ$$ meant nothing.」

stage0016_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then who was piloting that mobile suit...
　the $$シナンジュ$$...?」

stage0016_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If it wasn't $$シャア$$,
　then someone inheriting Zeon's Red Comet...?」

stage0016_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「And their skill matches $$シャア$$'s own...」

stage0016_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$クェス$$
「Aha, so this is where you were!」

stage0016_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You're... the Vice Chief of Staff's daughter?」

stage0016_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$クェス$$
「Just call me $$クェス$$.
　I'll call you $$アムロ$$ too.」

stage0016_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Sorry, $$アムロ$$.
　$$クェス$$... insisted she absolutely had to
　see you...」

stage0016_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$クェス$$
「You're not the only one I wanted to see, $$アムロ$$.
　$$カミーユ$$ too.」

stage0016_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$クェス$$
「Londo Bell is amazing.
　It's not just people like $$アムロ$$ and $$カミーユ$$,
　there's $$シン$$, and that $$バナージ$$ kid too.」

stage0016_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You two came to see Captain $$アムロ$$ too...」

stage0016_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But was it really all right, $$バナージ$$?
　Becoming an Anaheim test pilot for real...」

stage0016_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm the only one who can move the Unicorn...」

stage0016_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I'm sorry, $$バナージ$$...
　You're pushing yourself because of me...」

stage0016_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Still, that $$アルベルト$$ guy is
　pretty ruthless...」

stage0016_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「To talk a reluctant $$バナージ$$ into it,
　he even offered to hire $$オードリー$$ too in the end.」

stage0016_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't worry about it, $$オードリー$$.
　I decided this myself.」

stage0016_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Well, thanks to that, $$ミコット$$ and I
　also get to stay on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$
　as gofers too.」

stage0016_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$シン$$
「Are you two sure? This ship...
　it's still got fighting ahead of it.」

stage0016_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$シン$$
「It's not too late even now,
　you should get off at X-18999.」

stage0016_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Even if we got off, there's nowhere to go.
　I hear Industrial 7 is a mess,
　and the Anaheim campus is being relocated too.」

stage0016_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「With the world like this, we need to find
　our own way to survive too.」

stage0016_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シン$$
「Figures you're $$沙慈$$'s classmate.
　Getting swept into a fight by chance, too.」

stage0016_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「That's it!
　I was so surprised $$沙慈$$ knew
　$$カミーユ$$ and the others!」

stage0016_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's as far as that story goes.
　$$沙慈$$'s just an unrelated student now.」

stage0016_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ミコット$$... sorry, but could you
　look after $$オードリー$$ for me?」

stage0016_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Staying on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ isn't just
　about getting to work on mobile suits,
　that's not the only reason!」

stage0016_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$! Can I get your autograph!」

stage0016_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Yes!
　Getting to meet the Federation's White Meteor
　like this, I'm so moved!」

stage0016_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Ugh...
　I'm not some idol like $$ランカ$$
　or $$シェリル$$, though...」

stage0016_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「No, no!
　Captain $$アムロ$$ in the RX-78 is basically
　a god to me!」

stage0016_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「I've read countless biographies of the $$一年戦争$$
　that cover your death match with the Red Comet!」

stage0016_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$オードリー$$
（So this is $$アムロ・レイ$$...）

stage0016_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$クェス$$
「You... do you hate $$アムロ$$?」

stage0016_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$クェス$$
「No use hiding it.
　You've been glaring daggers this whole time.」

stage0016_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Cut it out, $$クェス$$.
　Don't go peeking into people's hearts like that.」

stage0016_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$クェス$$
「But... isn't that what Newtypes are?
　Laying bare everything someone's hiding...」

stage0016_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「...I don't think that's it...」

stage0016_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Understanding each other without misreading
　needs mutual respect to matter.
　Prying into hearts without that is tactless.」

stage0016_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$クェス$$
「...Yeah, you're right.
　I think $$ハサウェイ$$'s got a point.」

stage0016_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$クェス$$
「Sorry, $$オードリー$$.
　That was rude of me.」

stage0016_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$オードリー$$
「N-no... I'm not bothered by it.」

stage0016_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If a Newtype's what $$ハサウェイ$$ describes,
　I figure they could change the world
　without starting wars...」

stage0016_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's true.
　Until we can do that, this 'Newtype' thing
　is just a pipe dream.」

stage0016_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I've heard Captain $$アムロ$$ is a Newtype...」

stage0016_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Didn't I just say?
　Someone who's still fighting wars
　can't be a true Newtype.」

stage0016_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's why I'm counting on it.
　That a generation like $$カミーユ$$'s,
　like yours, will get there...」

stage0016_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you saying I have the makings
　of a Newtype too?」

stage0016_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not what I meant.
　What I'm counting on is the youth in you
　that fought so hard to protect $$オードリー$$.」

stage0016_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$シン$$
「Part of it's being a legendary ace pilot,
　but he's also an adult.」

stage0016_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$カツ$$
「Maybe so, but back in the $$一年戦争$$,
　$$アムロ$$ was pretty childish
　himself.」

stage0016_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$カツ$$
「Getting slugged by Captain $$ブライト$$,
　sulking off the ship on his own...」

stage0016_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$シン$$
「That's ancient history.
　If we're going there, I wasn't exactly
　someone to be proud of either, not long ago.」

stage0016_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$シン$$
「Might not be all that different now, though...」

stage0016_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's not true, $$シン$$.
　You've got a real sense of purpose,
　and you're walking the path you chose.」

stage0016_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know what you were like before,
　but I think you've grown.」

stage0016_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$カツ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$, you really are an adult...」

stage0016_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh, I haven't gotten this old for nothing.」

stage0016_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$カツ$$
「N, no! That's not it!
　That's not what I meant!」

stage0016_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So even a teacher can joke around.」

stage0016_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Of course.
　Teachers are people too, you know.」

stage0016_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, right now I'm away from school,
　on my own private time too.」

stage0016_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$カツ$$
「Knowing them, they're probably running
　sims in the hangar, right?」

stage0016_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$シン$$
「Good chance to ask Captain $$アムロ$$
　about a pilot's mindset, don't you think?」

stage0016_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Guess there's no helping it...
　I'll go get them.」

stage0016_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Say what you will, but
　Miss $$スズネ$$ really is a teacher.」

stage0016_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Oh, it's just $n...
　You're good at hiding your presence.」

stage0016_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$n
「...I'll ask again.
　Where are you going?」

stage0016_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$n
「Using Londo Bell as a diversion
　to get to the L3 colony first?」

stage0016_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Heh... Thought you were just a student,
　but you've got sharp instincts.」

stage0016_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Just so you know, telling the captain won't
　help. We're not part of Londo Bell,
　so we're just doing as we please.」

stage0016_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Whoa, whoa... This isn't a hike.」

stage0016_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Heard from $$カミーユ$$ that you... want to get stronger?」

stage0016_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Then get Captain $$アムロ$$ to train you.
　His piloting skills are godlike.」

stage0016_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Hold on, $$ヒイロ$$!
　Don't decide this on your own!」

stage0016_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then you make them give it up.
　I can't.」

stage0016_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That's rare, hearing you say that...」

stage0016_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah, yeah, got it.
　Guess I'll clean up the mess, then...」

stage0016_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Honestly, talking someone out of it with
　eyes like that is beyond even me.」

stage0016_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$デュオ$$
「If your guardian says it's okay, fine by me.」

stage0016_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$デュオ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$ and I are getting ready to leave.
　If you're coming, hurry up.」

stage0016_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I heard most of that.
　...Why do you keep rushing into danger?」

stage0016_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$スズネ$$
「If you want to get stronger,
　just train harder aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.」

stage0016_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$スズネ$$
「In fact, compared to when you started,
　$$カミーユ$$ and the others say you've grown a lot.」

stage0016_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$n
「...That's not enough.
　I have to be able to fight in any situation.」

stage0016_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$n
「For that, I can't rely on just the $$ジェニオン$$.
　I need to master $$ブーストアップ$$ too, and
　learn to fight guerrilla style.」

stage0016_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...Why do you want to get stronger?」

stage0016_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Let me ask differently.
　What is it you intend to fight?」

stage0016_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Fight the war itself, like $$シン$$ does?
　Or not forgive invaders, like $$甲児$$'s group?」

stage0016_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$n
「I'll fight both the war and invaders...
　But...」

stage0016_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$スズネ$$
「All right.
　I won't ask any further for now...」

stage0016_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But when the time comes, promise you'll tell me.」

stage0016_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Isn't it obvious?
　To the colony, with $$ヒイロ$$ and the others.」

stage0016_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Of course I am.
　I'm your partner, after all.」

stage0016_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$n
「How long are we just going to sit here?」

stage0016_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$デュオ$$'s gone ahead and started investigating.
　We move once he contacts us.」

stage0016_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$n
「That Gundam pilot, $$トロワ・バートン$$...
　He's from the L3 colony, isn't he?」

stage0016_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$n
「If he's investigating undercover,
　there's a good chance the terrorists we've
　faced are tied to some L3 colony.」

stage0016_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$n
「And the most suspicious one is
　this X-18999 colony, still newly built.」

stage0016_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$n
「If they were to make a move, I figured
　it'd be during this exercise...
　That's about it.」

stage0016_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Mostly correct.
　No need to explain further, then.」

stage0016_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$n
「I want to ask something else.
　I hear you fought Earth's nations
　for the sake of the colonies.」

stage0016_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$n
「And now you fight for the Earth Federation?」

stage0016_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no intention of fighting for the Federation.」

stage0016_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I fight for my own sake.」

stage0016_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Or call it fighting for what I'm trying to protect.」

stage0016_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
???
「What you're trying to protect...
　Is it this twisted world?」

stage0016_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$五飛$$
「Answer me, $$ヒイロ$$!
　Are you in the right!?」

stage0016_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$シン$$
「What in the world is going on!?
　Who is that $$マリーメイア$$ person!
　And $$五飛$$ too!」

stage0016_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Calm down, $$シン$$.
　We're just as stumped about $$五飛$$.」

stage0016_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$デュオ$$, tell us everything you know about $$五飛$$.」

stage0016_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$デュオ$$
「After the $$再世戦争$$, we...
　sealed away the Gundams at $$カトル$$'s suggestion.」

stage0016_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$デュオ$$
「But $$五飛$$ disappeared without a trace...
　And today's shocking reunion is the result.」

stage0016_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But since a situation might need the Gundams
　again, $$カトル$$ entrusted the ones he'd stored
　to $$プリベンター$$.」

stage0016_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ノイン$$
「So on $$レディ・アン$$'s orders,
　the Gundams were delivered to $$ヒイロ$$ and the others.」

stage0016_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
Noin
「I'm $$ルクレツィア・ノイン$$.
　A $$プリベンター$$, codename Fire.」

stage0016_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
Hilde
「I'm $$ヒルデ・シュバイカー$$.
　I've been helping $$プリベンター$$ alongside $$デュオ$$,
　and now I've ended up joining this operation.」

stage0016_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Do we know anything
　about the $$マリーメイア$$ army?」

stage0016_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ノイン$$
「That group's backed by the Barton Foundation.」

stage0016_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$シン$$
「Does that have something to do with $$トロワ$$?」

stage0016_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ノイン$$
「I don't know the details, but
　the $$トロワ・バートン$$ we know goes by a fake name,
　and the real $$トロワ・バートン$$ is someone else.」

stage0016_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ノイン$$
「And the Barton Foundation was also a sponsor
　of 《$$オペレーション・メテオ$$》.」

stage0016_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$オペレーション・メテオ$$...
　The plan to drop five Gundams on Earth
　and strike the nations that ruled the colonies...?」

stage0016_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ノイン$$
「But the Barton Foundation's true wish wasn't
　colony liberation, but to become the new ruler
　of the Earth Sphere themselves...」

stage0016_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ノイン$$
「And now, they've declared war
　on the newly formed Earth Federation.」

stage0016_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$デュオ$$
「So they're still carrying out
　$$オペレーション・メテオ$$, huh.」

stage0016_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$シン$$
「But their plan to destroy colonies and stir
　up Spacenoid rage already failed.
　That should slow their momentum.」

stage0016_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アムロ$$
「On the contrary, this failure might push them
　toward more extreme methods.」

stage0016_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No... if the unit holding the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ back
　at L1 turns out to be the $$マリーメイア$$ army, then
　the two are already working together, I'd say.」

stage0016_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Will this... turn into a war...?」

stage0016_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't know...
　But there's no doubt Earth is in crisis.」

stage0016_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$グラハム$$
「What's got an ace of the Earth Federation
　so startled?」

stage0016_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You're $$グラハム・エーカー$$, aren't you!
　And Milliardo Peacecraft too!」

stage0016_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
Zechs
「I'm going by $$ゼクス・マーキス$$ again now.」

stage0016_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'm prepared to accept the blame.」

stage0016_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's cold, you two!
　Why didn't you just tell me who you were!」

stage0016_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You're a soldier of the Earth Federation now?
　Then you're my comrade!」

stage0016_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You've owned up to the past,
　and that's why you're fighting for the Federation
　now, right? Then I've got nothing to say.」

stage0016_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But now that I think about it, it's incredible...
　Aces from OZ, the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$, and the AEU
　were fighting side by side.」

stage0016_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Just as I thought, you are...」

stage0016_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Well then, $$ゼクス$$...
　I'll report this matter to $$プリベンター$$ HQ with him.」

stage0016_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Understood.
　I'll join Londo Bell together with $$ノイン$$.」

stage0016_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$グラハム$$
「My friend...
　Someday, let's fight together again.」

stage0016_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Heh... I'll look forward to that day.」

stage0016_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
Graham
「Kid...
　If you see him, tell him $$グラハム・エーカー$$
　sends his regards...」

stage0016_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$グラハム$$
「No... never mind.
　I should thank him myself.」

stage0016_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「See you, $$ゼクス$$!
　I'm looking forward to meeting again!」

stage0016_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「...If you have something to say, speak freely.」

stage0016_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$n
「$F.
　I was teamed up with $$ヒイロ$$ in the earlier battle.」

stage0016_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
Zechs
「I'm $$ゼクス・マーキス$$.
　Pleased to meet you.」

stage0016_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$n
「...Why has Milliardo Peacecraft
　come out into the light like this?」

stage0016_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$n
「Shouldn't you, as the leader of $$ホワイトファング$$,
　be taking responsibility for that?」

stage0016_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Fighting like this is my own way of atoning.」

stage0016_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$n
「Do you think the people who lost someone
　dear to them in that war can accept that!?」

stage0016_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I have no words to answer with.」

stage0016_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$n
「But if you say you'll keep fighting anyway,
　I'll be watching to see your resolve.」

stage0016_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm sorry.
　They're not a bad person, just sensitive
　about people losing their lives...」

stage0016_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I think of myself as... their partner.」

stage0016_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Then let me offer just one warning.
　Their eyes are full of anger and sorrow...」

stage0016_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「The eyes of one who lost something and vowed revenge.」

stage0016_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...That's the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s new mission.」

stage0016_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$オットー$$
「Understood.
　This ship will re-enter the atmosphere with
　the $$プリベンター$$s and link up with other units...」

stage0016_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$オットー$$
「After that, we'll cooperate with $$プリベンター$$
　and $$ミスリル$$, and act as the moment demands.」

stage0016_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I'm leaving $$アムロ$$ in your hands.
　Make use of him.」

stage0016_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$オットー$$
「Are you sure?
　With Neo Zeon, and now the $$マリーメイア$$ army
　as well, both already on the move...」

stage0016_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Acting rashly with a hardline stance here
　would only embolden the regulars' Earth supremacists.」

stage0016_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll build up our forces here,
　while watching how the colonies react.」

stage0016_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ブライト$$
「On your side, counter this new threat to
　humanity, including today's Unknowns.」

stage0016_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$オットー$$
「Understood.
　Stay safe as well, Commander.」

stage0016_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The road ahead for the Earth Sphere is a hard one...」

stage0016_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$メラン$$
「Alien invaders, the Angels, the $$マーティアル$$ Order...
　and now today's Unknowns as well...」

stage0016_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「The Earth Federation Forces exist to counter
　them. I'm counting on you, everyone.」

stage0016_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「$$クェス$$ and I will get off the $$ラー・カイラム$$ here.
　Captain $$ブライト$$, your son helped with my daughter.」

stage0016_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「No...
　$$ハサウェイ$$ will be sad too, having to part
　ways with your daughter.」

stage0016_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$アデナウアー$$
「Once things settle down, we may meet again.
　For that, I wish Londo Bell good fortune.」

stage0016_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ブライト$$
（The gap between HQ and the front, Earth
　supremacists rising... a new Red Comet, $$マリーメイア$$...）

stage0016_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ブライト$$
（It's only a matter of time before Neo Zeon rises...）

stage0016_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...I'll report our operation's progress so far.」

stage0016_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You're an impatient one, aren't you...
　Can't you wait for your superior's glass to empty?」

stage0016_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Now that rank no longer means anything,
　there's no hierarchy between you and me.」

stage0016_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「If you're going to call yourself my superior,
　I'd like to see you act like one.」

stage0016_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's such a boring assignment,
　so let me at least enjoy some games and drinks.
　You understand, don't you, honey?」

stage0016_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Quit clicking your tongue at me.
　The cares of this world get mixed into the drink.」

stage0016_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...Can I give my report now?」

stage0016_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'd like you to finish before the next drink arrives.」

stage0016_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Space is showing some slight deviation,
　but it's proceeding roughly as planned.」

stage0016_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「For Japan, I moved forces per your orders,
　but a similar deviation has occurred there too.」

stage0016_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「As for 《$$マーティアル$$》, there's no problem
　seeing it as proceeding on our schedule.」

stage0016_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So space and Japan both show deviation...
　In your view, is that a dangerous level?」

stage0016_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「To confirm that, I intend to go check
　on the uncertain factor myself.」

stage0016_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Roger that.
　In the meantime, I'll step out for a bit.」

stage0016_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Where do you intend to go?」

stage0016_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's about time I say hello to this planet's
　caretaker. Sounds like our showing up sent them
　into a panic, trying to do their job anyway.」

stage0016_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...So this will accelerate things now.」

stage0016_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The countdown's already begun.
　Let's enjoy the game till the clock strikes zero.」

stage0016_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my... $n.
　You seem to be in quite the mood.」

stage0016_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$n
「...The ones who came when the $$ジェニオン$$ fell
　into this world have shown up again.」

stage0016_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$n
「On top of that, they acted like they
　were supporting the $$マリーメイア$$ army.」

stage0016_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Could it be, $n...
　that you suspect I'm connected to them?」

stage0016_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$n
「That's not my intent.
　But if you're hiding something, tell me all.」

stage0016_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's just as I already reported.
　They likely got caught up in a dimensional
　tremor and came here, same as the $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0016_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even if you ask me that,
　there are things even I don't know...」

stage0016_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, I swear it on this body of steel!」

stage0016_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no...
　I actually quite like that surprisingly
　honest side of you, $n.」

stage0016_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, now that you feel better,
　let's get fired up today too... business, business!」
